response.sql: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS fee_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_fee_count FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.fee_count) AS total_fee_count, AVG(g.fee_count - a.avg_fee_count) AS average_count_excess FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_average AS a WHERE g.fee_count > a.avg_fee_count;

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is excluded from the average.
